surfaces.label: JWT issuance and verification
surfaces.notes: Fixed signing default and direct subject trust permit administrator token forgery.

surfaces.label: Public font file serving
surfaces.notes: Unauthenticated Windows path traversal reaches arbitrary readable files.

surfaces.label: Poster capability and public track reads
surfaces.notes: Default capability gates arbitrary track metadata and coordinate reads.

surfaces.label: Shared-track map tooltips
surfaces.notes: Imported point fields reach innerHTML and vendor HTML APIs without encoding.

surfaces.label: Live-recording placeholder response
surfaces.notes: Unvalidated path token is reflected into executable HTML before lookup.

surfaces.label: Interpolation ownership
surfaces.notes: Track and interpolation IDs are not bound to the caller.

surfaces.label: Overlay export ownership
surfaces.notes: Track and template IDs are loaded without owner predicates before rendering.

surfaces.label: Poster generation ownership
surfaces.notes: Authenticated track_id is rendered with the server-held secret without ownership checks.

surfaces.label: Private overlay template visibility
surfaces.notes: Direct detail, preview, export, and duplicate routes bypass the list visibility policy.

surfaces.label: Debug log relay
surfaces.notes: Public POST/WS endpoints can relay full live-recording tokens from frontend logs.

surfaces.label: Generated export storage
surfaces.notes: Static /exports is unauthenticated and filenames use predictable ID and timestamp components.

surfaces.label: User font upload path handling
surfaces.notes: The path write lacks basename normalization, but the current API omits the required is_admin argument and fails before writing.

surfaces.label: Share token generation
surfaces.notes: random.choices is not preferred, but practical prediction or brute force was not established; use secrets for hardening.

surfaces.label: Public map-layer configuration
surfaces.notes: Map keys are intended for browser SDKs; provider-side restrictions are external. Geocoding config is not public.

surfaces.label: SQL construction
surfaces.notes: Spatial queries use bound parameters; dynamic table names come from a fixed internal level map.

surfaces.label: Invite-code consumption
surfaces.notes: Separate validate and consume transactions may permit a max_uses race.

surfaces.label: KML and XML parsing
surfaces.notes: Default lxml parser options should be hardened and tested.

surfaces.label: Administrative archive imports
surfaces.notes: Uncompressed-size and file-count budgets are absent; traversal behavior is dependency-specific.
